svg.title: One symptom, one tool. Guessing is what the other tools are for.
svg.desc: A five-row routing table: each symptom on the left — will not compile, crashes, wrong answer with no crash, fine at -O0 but broken at -O2, memory corruption — points by arrow to the single tool that diagnoses it. On the right, AddressSanitizer's shadow bytes fa fa 05 fa are drawn as cells with 05 highlighted, and three bars compare 65 ms plain, 179 ms with sanitizers and 180 ms at -O0. A crossed-out box rejects scattering printf calls, and an lldb backtrace shows frame one highlighted as the first line you wrote.
svg.text: One symptom, one tool. Guessing is what the other tools are for.
the one tool that finds it
read the FIRST error, not last
lldb: run, bt, frame select, p
pay at -O0. So turn it on.
branch 3 only - and a test beats it there
errors. The first is real. The other
frame #0 is inside libc. Frame #1 is the
first line YOU wrote - start there.
